pages.text: The Immortal Furnace has three parallel lanes. True Yuan processes one item per lane in 50 ticks; Immortal Yuan processes one stack in 25 ticks. The embedded furnace can refill the previous full input batch and return output to storage.

From stage 6, the personal Xianqiao is bound to a persistent ImmortalStorage identity instead of the launcher's current session UUID. On first load of a 0.0.8-or-earlier save, one reliable legacy realm or consistent bound-item clue performs a single migration. Without reliable evidence, the old directory is preserved rather than guessed or overwritten.

Usable space expands through 3x3, 7x7, and 19x19. Leaving the boundary warns and returns you to the nearest legal position, only while inside your own realm. Starting the same account through another launcher keeps the realm, inventory, and Xianqiao storage on one identity.

Stage limits unlock time scaling: up to 4x at stage 7, 0.2-8x at stage 8, 0.1-16x at stage 9, and freeze through 32x at stage 10. Management toggles noon/midnight and cycles clear, rain, thunder, and snow. Weather is realm-local; snow is client particles and never enables server precipitation.
